title: The Direct Scattering Transform for the Intermediate Long Wave Equation
summary: In this paper, we provide a rigorous study of the direct scattering problem proposed by Kodama, Ablowitz and Satsuma for the complete integrability theory of the Intermediate Long Wave (ILW) equation. We derive the Lax operators for ILW, and study their spectral theory. We show finiteness and simplicity of the discrete spectrum, existence and uniqueness of the Jost solutions, and construct the scattering data for the Lax operator.
